question.worked_solution:
First we apply the quotient rule, subtracting exponents in the fraction:

$$
\begin{aligned}\begin{aligned}{v}^{9}\cdot \frac{{v}^{5}}{{v}^{12}} & = \\ {v}^{9}\cdot {v}^{5-12} & = \\ {v}^{9}\cdot {v}^{-7} & \end{aligned}\end{aligned}
$$

Then we apply the product rule, adding exponents in the product:

$$
\begin{aligned}\begin{aligned}{v}^{9}\cdot {v}^{-7} & = \\ {v}^{9+(-7)} & = \\ {v}^{9-7} & = \\ {v}^{2}\end{aligned}\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore,

$$
\begin{aligned}\begin{aligned}{v}^{9}\cdot \frac{{v}^{5}}{{v}^{12}}={v}^{2}.\end{aligned}\end{aligned}
$$
